# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
library(writexl)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
```

# Table 1

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Helper: binary summary (FIXES THE BUG)
# ---------------------------
fmt_binary <- function(x) {
  n_yes   <- sum(x == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_known <- sum(!is.na(x))

  if (n_known == 0) return("NA")

  paste0(
    n_yes,
    " (",
    round(100 * n_yes / n_known, 1),
    ")"
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# Prepare HIV data
# ---------------------------
table1_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(
      Subgroup,
      levels = c(
        "Primary HIV infection",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Elite controller"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    NNRTI = case_when(
      ART == "NNRTI" ~ "Yes",
      is.na(ART)     ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE           ~ "No"
    ),
    INSTI = case_when(
      ART == "INSTI" ~ "Yes",
      is.na(ART)     ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE           ~ "No"
    ),
    `Other ART` = case_when(
      is.na(ART)                  ~ NA_character_,
      !ART %in% c("NNRTI","INSTI") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                         ~ "No"
    ),
    Abacavir = case_when(
      is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    Tenofovir = case_when(
      is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "tenofovir") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    `Other backbone` = case_when(
      is.na(`Backbone 2`) ~ NA_character_,
      !str_detect(tolower(`Backbone 2`), "abacavir|tenofovir") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    `HIV-RNA (baseline)`  = log10(`HIV-RNA (baseline)` + 1),
    `HIV-RNA (follow-up)` = log10(`HIV-RNA (follow-up)` + 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    ID, Subgroup, Sex,

    Age_bl  = `Age (baseline)`,
    BMI_bl  = `BMI (baseline)`,
    CD4_bl  = `CD4 cell count (baseline)`,
    CD4CD8_bl = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    HIVRNA_bl = `HIV-RNA (baseline)`,

    Age_fu  = `Age (follow-up)`,
    BMI_fu  = `BMI (follow-up)`,
    CD4_fu  = `CD4 cell count (follow-up)`,
    CD4CD8_fu = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`,
    HIVRNA_fu = `HIV-RNA (follow-up)`,

    `Months on treatment`,
    NNRTI, INSTI, `Other ART`,
    Abacavir, Tenofovir, `Other backbone`
  ) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Helper test functions
# ---------------------------
kw <- function(df, var) {
  tryCatch(
    kruskal.test(df[[var]] ~ df$Subgroup)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

fisher <- function(df, var) {
  tryCatch(
    fisher.test(table(df[[var]], df$Subgroup))$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# P-values
# ---------------------------
pvals <- tibble(
  Variable = c(
    "N",
    "Female, n (%)",
    "Male, n (%)",

    "Age (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "BMI (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "CD4 count (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline), median (IQR)",
    "HIV RNA (baseline, log10), median (IQR)",

    "Age (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "BMI (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "CD4 count (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up), median (IQR)",
    "HIV RNA (follow-up, log10), median (IQR)",

    "Months on treatment, median (IQR)",
    "NNRTI, n (%)",
    "INSTI, n (%)",
    "Other ART, n (%)",
    "Abacavir, n (%)",
    "Tenofovir, n (%)",
    "Other backbone, n (%)"
  ),
  `P-value` = c(
    NA,
    fisher(table1_df, "Sex"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Sex"),

    kw(table1_df, "Age_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "BMI_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4CD8_bl"),
    kw(table1_df, "HIVRNA_bl"),

    kw(table1_df, "Age_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "BMI_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "CD4CD8_fu"),
    kw(table1_df, "HIVRNA_fu"),

    kw(table1_df, "Months on treatment"),
    fisher(table1_df, "NNRTI"),
    fisher(table1_df, "INSTI"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Other ART"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Abacavir"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Tenofovir"),
    fisher(table1_df, "Other backbone")
  )
)

# ---------------------------
# Summary table (CORRECT COUNTS)
# ---------------------------
summary_long <- table1_df |>
  group_by(Subgroup) |>
  reframe(
    Variable = pvals$Variable,
    Value = c(
      n(),

      paste0(sum(Sex == "F", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             round(100 * mean(Sex == "F", na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),

      paste0(sum(Sex == "M", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             round(100 * mean(Sex == "M", na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),

      paste0(median(Age_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(Age_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(Age_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(BMI_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(BMI_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(BMI_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(CD4_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(CD4_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(CD4CD8_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4CD8_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(CD4CD8_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(HIVRNA_bl, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(HIVRNA_bl, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(HIVRNA_bl, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(Age_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(Age_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(Age_fu, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(BMI_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(BMI_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(BMI_fu, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(CD4_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(CD4_fu, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(CD4CD8_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(CD4CD8_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(CD4CD8_fu, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(HIVRNA_fu, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(HIVRNA_fu, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(HIVRNA_fu, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      paste0(median(`Months on treatment`, na.rm = TRUE), " (",
             quantile(`Months on treatment`, .25, na.rm = TRUE), "–",
             quantile(`Months on treatment`, .75, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),

      fmt_binary(NNRTI),
      fmt_binary(INSTI),
      fmt_binary(`Other ART`),
      fmt_binary(Abacavir),
      fmt_binary(Tenofovir),
      fmt_binary(`Other backbone`)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Final table & export
# ---------------------------
summary_wide <- summary_long |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Subgroup, values_from = Value) |>
  left_join(pvals, by = "Variable")

table1_gt <- summary_wide |>
  gt(rowname_col = "Variable") |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Clinical characteristics of the HIV cohort",
    subtitle = "Baseline and follow-up measurements stratified by HIV-1 Subgroup"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = `P-value`, decimals = 3) |>
  tab_source_note(
    md("Percentages are calculated among patients with known treatment or backbone information.")
  )

table1_gt
```

# Save table

## Table 1

```{r}
write.xlsx(
  summary_wide,
  "../tables/Table1_HIV_baseline_followup.xlsx",
  rowNames = TRUE
)
```

## Supplementary Table 1

Age and sex distribution of all cohorts in the study.

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(Class = case_when(
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "HIV (baseline)",
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "HIV (follow-up)",
    TRUE             ~ Timepoint
  )) |>
  group_by(Class, Sex) |>
  count() |>
  # Make M to Male and F to Female in Sex
  mutate(Sex = case_when(
    Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
    Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
    TRUE ~ Sex
  )) |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Supplementary Table 1.xlsx")

# Age distribution, median and IQR1 and IQR3
metadata |>
  mutate(Class = case_when(
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "HIV (baseline)",
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "HIV (follow-up)",
    TRUE             ~ Timepoint
  )) |>
  group_by(Class) |>
  summarise(
    Age_median = median(`Age (baseline)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR1   = quantile(`Age (baseline)`, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR3   = quantile(`Age (baseline)`, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

metadata |>
  mutate(Class = case_when(
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "HIV (baseline)",
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "HIV (follow-up)",
    TRUE             ~ Timepoint
  )) |>
  group_by(Class) |>
  summarise(
    Age_median = median(`Age (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR1   = quantile(`Age (follow-up)`, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR3   = quantile(`Age (follow-up)`, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

metadata |>
  mutate(Class = case_when(
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "HIV (baseline)",
    Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "HIV (follow-up)",
    TRUE             ~ Timepoint
  )) |>
  group_by(Class) |>
  summarise(
    Age_median = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR1   = quantile(Age, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_IQR3   = quantile(Age, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Supplementary Table 6

Summary statistics DPA

```{r}
# A function to summarize the results better
format_de_results <- function(df, suffix) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Significantly increased",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Significantly decreased",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      Feature,
      !!paste0("logFC_", suffix)      := logFC,
      !!paste0("P.Value_", suffix)   := P.Value,
      !!paste0("adj.P.Val_", suffix) := adj.P.Val,
      !!paste0("sig_", suffix)       := sig
    )
}
```

## Supplementary Table 9

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create mapping table: Entrez → Symbol
# --------------------------------------------------

entrez_to_symbol <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(unlist(strsplit(gsea_go_hiv_healthy$core_enrichment, "/"))),
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  columns = "SYMBOL"
) |>
  distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert core_enrichment column
# --------------------------------------------------

gsea_go_hiv_healthy <- gsea_go_hiv_healthy |>
  mutate(
    core_enrichment_symbols = map_chr(core_enrichment, function(x) {
      
      ids <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
      
      symbols <- entrez_to_symbol |>
        filter(ENTREZID %in% ids) |>
        arrange(match(ENTREZID, ids)) |>   # 🔑 keep original order
        pull(SYMBOL)
      
      paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
    })
  ) |>
  select(-core_enrichment) |>
  rename(core_enrichment = core_enrichment_symbols)

gsea_kegg_hiv_healthy <- gsea_kegg_hiv_healthy |>
  mutate(
    core_enrichment_symbols = map_chr(core_enrichment, function(x) {
      
      ids <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
      
      symbols <- entrez_to_symbol |>
        filter(ENTREZID %in% ids) |>
        arrange(match(ENTREZID, ids)) |>   # 🔑 keep original order
        pull(SYMBOL)
      
      paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
    })
  ) |>
  select(-core_enrichment) |>
  rename(core_enrichment = core_enrichment_symbols)

gsea_reactome_hiv_healthy <- gsea_reactome_hiv_healthy |>
  mutate(
    core_enrichment_symbols = map_chr(core_enrichment, function(x) {
      
      ids <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
      
      symbols <- entrez_to_symbol |>
        filter(ENTREZID %in% ids) |>
        arrange(match(ENTREZID, ids)) |>   # 🔑 keep original order
        pull(SYMBOL)
      
      paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
    })
  ) |>
  select(-core_enrichment) |>
  rename(core_enrichment = core_enrichment_symbols)
```
